title: GenRec: An LLM-Backed Recommendation Ranker at Netflix
abstract: arXiv:2608.10257v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are reshaping recommender systems by enabling richer modeling of users, content, and context directly in natural language. At Netflix, we are exploring this direction through GenRec, an LLM-backed recommendation ranker built on top of an in-house foundational LLM. GenRec follows a two-phase framework: Phase 1 adapts an open-source LLM to Netflix data, developing deep understanding of the catalog and member behavior while balancing capabilities such as content understanding and instruction following. Phase 2 post-trains this foundation model with recommendation-ranking specific data, labels, and reward signals, aiming to align the ranker with business requirements and long-term member satisfaction.   This paper focuses on Phase 2 and the transition from a traditional discriminative ranker with thousands of engineered features to an LLM-backed ranker driven by verbalized user histories and context. translated_title: GenRec：Netflix基于大语言模型支持的推荐排序器
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）正在通过直接在自然语言中对用户、内容和上下文进行更丰富的建模，重塑推荐系统。在Netflix，我们通过GenRec探索这一方向，这是一个基于内部基础LLM构建的LLM支持的推荐排序器。GenRec采用两阶段框架：第一阶段将开源LLM适配到Netflix数据，深入理解目录和会员行为，同时平衡内容理解和指令遵循等能力。第二阶段使用推荐排序特定数据、标签和奖励信号对该基础模型进行后训练，旨在使排序器与业务需求和长期会员满意度对齐。本文聚焦于第二阶段，以及从具有数千个工程化特征的传统判别式排序器向由语言化用户历史和上下文驱动的LLM支持排序器的转变。我们描述了这一转变过程及关键发现。
tldr: 本文介绍了Netflix的GenRec系统，通过两阶段框架将LLM适配为推荐排序器，用语言化用户历史替代传统工程化特征，实现更丰富的上下文建模和业务对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Netflix's GenRec system, which uses a two-phase framework to adapt an LLM into a recommendation ranker, replacing traditional engineered features with verbalized user histories for richer contextual modeling and business alignment.
